 'sat+P2exp': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P+p[3]*(1-np.exp(-p[4]*t))+p[5]*P*P*np.exp(-p[6]*t),

 'logistic_t': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P+p[3]/(1+np.exp(-p[4]*(t-p[5])))+p[6]*P*np.exp(-p[7]*t),

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
out=[]
def run(f,n,name):
    best=None
    for s in range(60):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(s); p0=rng.uniform(-3,3,n); p0[-1]=rng.uniform(0.05,2)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dP_dt,p0,max_nfev=3000)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    out.append((name, round(float(np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt)),7), best.x.round(4).tolist()))

run(lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P+p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*t)+p[5]*np.sin(p[6]*t+p[7]),8,'exp+sin')
run(lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P+p[3]*t+p[4]*np.sin(p[5]*t)+p[6]*np.cos(p[5]*t)+ p[7]*np.exp(-p[8]*t),9,'lin t, osc, exp')
